assumptions.cloud_model: Current production code does not read a Gaussian cloud section; this template represents sigma_cloud=1 mm by a full 3-sigma cylinder: R=3 mm, Lz=6 mm.
assumptions.control_beam: User specified control 2sigma = 500 um. With code convention field ~ exp(-r^2/w0^2), intensity sigma = w0/2, so w0_control = 500 um and FWHM diameter = w0*sqrt(2 ln 2).
assumptions.signal_beam: Signal/control FWHM diameter ratio copied from Jutisz: 120/210.

notes.important: This will try to simulate 1e8 atoms. That is faithful to the request but extremely heavy. For debugging, reduce sim.sim_density by a large factor.
